If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.23),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{(0.77)}^{x-1}(0.23), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3<X<7) & =P(X\in \{4,5,6\}) \\  & =P(X=4)+P(X=5)+P(X=6) \\  & =f(4)+f(5)+f(6) \\  & ={(0.77)}^{3}(0.23)+{(0.77)}^{4}(0.23)+{(0.77)}^{5}(0.23) \\  & ≈0.2481.\end{aligned}
$$
